ex.s: This sense of uncertainty led me to think about the meaning of zero.
ex.t: 这种不确定感让我开始思考零的意义。

ex.s: If it is not turned in by the 4th day after the due date, it will earn a zero.
ex.t: 如果在到期日之后的第4天之前尚未交接，则将获得零分。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: Zero waste was a radical lifestyle movement a few years back.
ex.t: 零浪费在几年前还是一场激进的生活方式运动。

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费杂货罐回来，我爸爸评论说，我到处带着罐子真是傻。

ex.s: I also offered to cook every so often, so I portioned out a bit of the cupboard for my own zero waste groceries.
ex.t: 我也主动提出偶尔做饭，所以我在橱柜里分出一点空间存放自己零废弃的杂货。

ex.s: Lang is only too aware that as soon as a team steps off the victory podium, they need to start from zero to prepare for new challenges ahead.
ex.t: Lang非常清楚，一旦团队走出胜利领奖台，他们就需要从零开始，为未来的新挑战做好准备。

ex.s: In the 1980s, the team suddenly became famous in the international volleyball scene with several major world titles, and they beat the United States three to zero in the final of the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics.
ex.t: 20世纪80年代，这支队伍突然在国际排球赛场上声名鹊起，获得了多个重要的世界冠军头衔，并在1984年洛杉矶奥运会决赛中以三比零击败了美国队。

ex.s: Put on a spacesuit, exit the capsule and go on your incredibly lifelike spacewalk in a world with zero gravity.
ex.t: 穿上太空服，走出舱门，在零重力的世界里开始你难以置信的逼真太空漫步。

ex.s: In this zero gravity world, there is no up or down, and while sleeping on the ceiling might sound like fun, astronauts need to be strapped to sleeping compartments to protect themselves from injury.
ex.t: 在这个零重力世界里，没有上下之分，尽管睡在天花板上听起来有趣，宇航员仍需被固定在睡眠舱里以防受伤。
